name: AHV without work at 55 with CHF 2,000,000 and a BVG bridging annuity of CHF 30,000, Zurich
workings: AHV without work: base = net wealth 2,000,000 (the 3a account doesn't count) + 20 × 30,000.00 = 2,600,000.00; contribution 6,307.00 (3,604 + 159 per completed 50,000 above 1,750,000), + 5% admin costs = 6,622.35.
The BVG bridging annuity of 30,000.00 is income:
Simple tax 606.5000; cantonal 95% = 576.1750; communal (Zurich, 119%) = 721.7350; personal tax 24.
The year is a full AHV year: 12 months, credited with the minimum contribution's income 4,934.4828 in prepare (the wealth isn't known there).
